thread:
maris: Quick thread  need final customer-facing copy + timing + inbound-routing plan for the EU blip earlier. Draft below.

maris: DRAFT status + email header:

We experienced degraded inference performance in the EU region between 02:22 and 02:48 UTC. A network routing change impacted requests to a subset of GPU clusters; the change was rolled back and services returned to normal at 02:48 UTC. Traffic and health checks are passing. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident. A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours outlining root cause and mitigations.

maris: Recommendation: post short status now (RESOLVED), send detailed email to Dedicated & Private within 45m, hosted banner + short hosted email in 3h, full postmortem in 72h. Tag all comms with "incident-eu-07-2026".

tony: Wording tweak: change "network routing change" -> "networking configuration change" (clearer). Also for the Dedicated subject: "Service update  EU region (resolved)  impact & next steps".

jess: Support estimate: expect 8-20 tickets. Please include header/tag "incident-eu-07-2026" in subject and internal headers so we can auto-filter. SEs should proactively call customers with >10% EU traffic; ops can generate list in 25m.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-072 recorded: EU inference degradation  resolved at 1769950288 (02:48 UTC). Postmortem owner: @eng-runtime.

sales-ops: Routing note: any demo/trial requests or renewal signals from affected customers -> sales-ops-incident channel. Do not forward to general SDR queue. Mark any upsell/renewal risk tickets HIGH.

eng-runtime: Ops confirmed health checks green and traffic normalized. We'll provide a short verification line for the status page: "verified by automated health checks across EU clusters". Postmortem team scheduled.

tony: Small copy nit: "No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident." sounds better than the shorter version. Also include a direct support contact line in the email footer.

maris: Finalized copy for send (Dedicated/Private):

We experienced degraded inference performance in the EU region between 02:22 and 02:48 UTC. A networking configuration change impacted routing to a subset of GPU clusters; the change was reverted and services returned to normal at 02:48 UTC. Traffic has normalized and automated health checks across EU clusters are passing. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident. We will publish a post-incident report within 72 hours detailing root cause and planned mitigations.

If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai or your assigned SE.

jess: OK to send Dedicated & Private now; lists queued and SEs notified to call high-traffic accounts. I'll append the incident tag.

sales-ops: Sending rules confirmed. We'll triage inbound leads and route demo/renewal signals to account teams; sales-ops will post summary in sales-ops-incident.

maris: Thanks all. Action items: 1) post status page update (jamie to publish) 2) send Dedicated/Private email in 45m with incident tag 3) hosted banner in 3h 4) postmortem draft due in 72h. Closing loop: status to be set to RESOLVED with verification line. :thumbsup:
